name: PERFALLOC1-order
why: A three-term sum reordered differs from the base's in the double's last bit at most, and the matrix is float32: the two round to the same float unless the sum lands within ~1e-16 (relative) of a float32 rounding boundary - none in the pin's 4,000 random views and 24,000 lantern faces (whose views are axis-aligned: every term but one exact). Recorded so the next reader knows the order is the base's on purpose (the same floats by construction), not by the pin.

name: PERFALLOC1-near
old: const proj = perspectiveInto(_faceProj, Math.PI / 2, 1, SHADOW_POINT_NEAR, far);
new: const proj = perspectiveInto(_faceProj, Math.PI / 2, 1, SHADOW_POINT_NEAR * 0.5, far);

name: PERFALLOC1-unnormalised
old:
x0 /= xl; x1 /= xl; x2 /= xl;

new:
x0 /= xl; x1 /= xl;
  const y0

name: PERFALLOC1-centre

new: lookAtInto(_faceView, pos, pos[0] + d[0], pos[1] + d[2], pos[2] + d[1], up)

name: PERFALLOC1-minted
old: multiply(proj, lookAtInto(_faceView, pos, pos[0] + d[0], pos[1] + d[1], pos[2] + d[2], up), out[f]);
new: multiply(proj, lookAt(pos, [pos[0] + d[0], pos[1] + d[1], pos[2] + d[2]], up), out[f]);

new: const rad = c[0], px = c[1], py = c[2], pz = c[3], far = c[4] - c[0];
